title: Baseball
text:
This site explores the history of Major League Baseball through the Lahman database, a record of every team and player season since 1871.
The Home runs page starts with a puzzle: total home runs seem to collapse in 1981, 1994, and 2020. The collapse is an illusion of shortened seasons — measured per game, those years are ordinary, and the rate instead reveals baseball’s real eras, from the dead-ball era to the 2019 “juiced ball.” The Sluggers page ranks the career home run leaders and finds most of them clustered in the steroid era, the same years the per-game rate peaked.
